sources.titleEn: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: FCN：密集預測與輸出步幅
related.titleEn: FCN: dense prediction and output stride
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付跳接座標圖與合成遮罩對齊報告。；兩案裁切量4與6正確，合成十字中心偏差為0格。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver skip-coordinate diagrams and synthetic-mask alignment reports.; Crops4 and6 match and the synthetic-cross center has zero-cell offset.
related.difference: 標出一條寬8像素細線穿越32像素粗格；畫低層細節與高層語義的融合節點。；64與256位置表吻合，標籤處理保持離散類別，評分排除padding。
related.differenceEn: Draw an8-pixel line crossing32-pixel coarse cells and the fusion of shallow detail with deep semantics.; Position counts match, labels stay discrete and scoring excludes padding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對稱中心裁切每邊c=(Hskip−Hup)/2；奇數差需明定偏置方向。；教學跳接寬64、上採樣寬56；另一案上採樣寬52。；c=(64−56)/2=4 px；改52時c=6 px。
輸出步幅S對應(H/S)(W/S)個粗網格位置；上採樣恢復尺寸但不自動恢復細節。；教學輸入256×256，比較S32與S16，整除且無邊界取整。；N=(256/32)²=64；S16時N=256。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Symmetric crop per side is c=(Hskip−Hup)/2; odd differences require an explicit directional convention.; Teaching skip width64, upsampled width56; alternative52.; c=(64−56)/2=4 px; width52 gives6 px.
Output stride S yields(H/S)(W/S) coarse positions; upsampling restores size but not automatically detail.; Teaching input256×256, S32 versus S16, exactly divisible.; N=(256/32)²=64; S16 gives256.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Transformer：縮放點積注意力
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付跳接座標圖與合成遮罩對齊報告。；兩案裁切量4與6正確，合成十字中心偏差為0格。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver skip-coordinate diagrams and synthetic-mask alignment reports.; Crops4 and6 match and the synthetic-cross center has zero-cell offset.
related.difference: 畫Q的Lq×dk、K的Lk×dk、V的Lk×dv及Lq×Lk分數矩陣，標softmax軸。；分數2與1吻合，矩陣乘法shape成立，遮罩及機率和測試通過。
related.differenceEn: Draw Q,K,V shapes and the Lq×Lk score matrix, labeling the softmax axis.; Scores2 and1 match, matrix shapes agree and mask/sum tests pass.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 對稱中心裁切每邊c=(Hskip−Hup)/2；奇數差需明定偏置方向。；教學跳接寬64、上採樣寬56；另一案上採樣寬52。；c=(64−56)/2=4 px；改52時c=6 px。
分數s=q·k/√dk；單一分數不是機率，需與其他有效key一起softmax。；教學q·k=8,dk=16；保持內積8改dk64作尺度對照。；s=8/√16=2；dk64時s=1。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Symmetric crop per side is c=(Hskip−Hup)/2; odd differences require an explicit directional convention.; Teaching skip width64, upsampled width56; alternative52.; c=(64−56)/2=4 px; width52 gives6 px.
Score s=q·k/√dk; a score is not a probability until softmax across valid keys.; Teaching dot product8,dk16; hold dot product8 while changing dk64.; s=8/√16=2; dk64 gives s=1.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
